data.name: Jassia
data.gender_notes: Jassia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-s-y', meaning 'to be gentle, soft, or beautiful'. Jassia evokes images of tranquility, grace, and femininity in Islamic culture. The name Jassia carries the meaning “Gentle, Soft, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jassia usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch of God's mercy and compassion.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jassia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.long_meaning: جاسيا هو اسم عربي مشتق من الجذر الصرف ز-ئ-ا، يرمز إلى سلوك السلطة والتماس، ويُعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم، ويُفضل في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية بسبب تأثيره الإيجابي على الشخصية والخلاقة، ويُشير إلى المظهر الخارجي للشخص وسلوكه في المجتمع.
